reason: Machine lens: every opcode is base 6502 or 65C02 already used here (PHY/PLY removed, nothing new). Recount, record_live path from STA rec_sh onwards: old LDA abs,X 4, STA abs,Y 5, PHY 3, LDY abs,X 4, TAX 2, TYA 2, JSR 6, PLY 4, then SEC 2, SBC zp 3, STA zp 3, TXA 2, SBC zp 3, AND 2, STA zp 3 = 48; new SEC 2, SBC zp 3, STA zp 3, LDA abs,X 4, STA abs,Y 5, SBC zp 3, AND 2, JSR 6, LDY zp 3 = 31: 17 saved (no page crossings: movers_screen_address_low/high at &13AA/&13CC with X <= &21 slots never cross, so the removed LDY abs,X had no +1). list_live: the dead STA wa_off+1 (zp &4A, named nowhere else in src/ or tools/) 3 saved. 2 x 17 + 2 x 3 = 40 a pass. Carry: LDA/STA between the two SBCs leave C. Bytes: old 16 + 2 (STA wa_off+1), new 20: +2. The label world_of_address.wa_hi_done_c1 uses the same .name-then-{ scope form as put_on.going_on (render.6502 543). No self-modified operand or code-read-as-data in record_live/world_of_address; kindcache's reads of draw_column.*_operand are symbolic. Branches: world_of_address's BCC/BRA stay in page &A0; scanning every branch from &A0F5 to bank 4's end in the shipping and gameplay listings, none starts or stops crossing a page with +2. Room: bank 4 ends &B37D (shipping), &B3F6 (gameplay), &B3F9 (fullredraw), &B3C4 (full gameplay set): +2 fits under REN_BASE &B400 in all. The +2 slide does cost a little that the claim leaves out: wa_rows_guess &A0F7,X crosses for X = 9, 10 too (+1, ~0.1 a pass); straight_sprite_hi &A4E6,X crosses for X = &1A, &1B too (+1 per draw of those sprites); ck_index &A3B4,Y crosses for Y = &4C, &4D too (player sprite 4 flipped, lines 4-5: +1); and the bank-4 straight sprites' (d_ptr),Y reads and draw_column's page-crossing paths move: modelled per unclipped draw (averaged over the 8 lines), 9 of the 19 bank-4 sprites change by -3.1 to +1.9 cycles a draw (&37 -3.1, &41/&43 -2.25, &3A +1.6, &3E/&48/&49 +1.9, &3D +0.75, &40 +0.5; sum +0.9 over one draw of each). Those are a few cycles a pass either way, well under the 40 saved: the candidate is right and still a net saving, but the gate's passbench should confirm the net, not the 40.
